plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Music AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 21, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7893/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 62-64; modeled total 64 = 15+16+15+18 (semester sums verified). MUIVI 410 Applied Music (1 unit) is genuinely repeated in all 4 semesters per the map's explicit footnote ('Students must enroll in MUIVI 410 each semester for 4 semesters'); allow_repeated_courses is true and documented here. MUFHL 405 lists MUFHL 402 & 403 as prerequisites; those courses are not sequenced in the map (the map sequences the combined MUFHL 400 instead) and are carried under external_prereqs. Semester 4 history/theory choice is footnoted 'a minimum of 3 units from these courses' (MUFHL 310/311/414 at 3 units, MUFHL 415 at 1 unit); 3 units used, though the semester header reads 16-18 units (the 16 figure would imply taking only the 1-unit MUFHL 415, contradicting the minimum-3-units footnote). The Semester 2 Cal-GETC Area 3B row prints 'BIOL 310 or 400, CHEM 305 and BIOL 440' in its prerequisite column, which appears to be a layout artifact; it is not modeled as a prerequisite of the GE choice slot. List A (large ensembles, minimum 8 units per map; MUP courses, each repeatable up to 4 times): 2+2+1 = 5 units are sequenced across Semesters 1, 2, and 4. The two Cal-GETC Area 4 slots must total 6 units from 2 disciplines per the map. Advisories are recommendations only, recorded in choice_notes, never as prereqs.
